--a celestial stream (गन्गा) which en- tered ब्रह्माण्ड from outside by its being pierced by the tip of the toe of Trivikrama's left foot; in course of time she reached the celestial region known as विष्णुपद; held sacred by Dhruva and the seven sages; crossing the region of the [page२-525+ ३३] moon she reaches the city of ब्रह्मा; there she divides into four branches and falls into the western and eastern seas. भा. V. १

(I)--The principal and eternal god;^1 the sum and substance of the three Vedas; भ।-- cherisher and supporter of the universe; ग,--the leader or creator; भग indicates six properties, dominion, might, glory, splendour, wisdom and detachment; व, elemental spirit in which all beings exist and which exists in all beings; thus it is the name of वासुदेव. Vi.
(III)--the quality of भग and सद्भाव। वा. 5. ३६.

--the son of दिलीप and father of श्रुत (Suhotra वि। प्।); by penance on the banks of the Bindusaras he succeeded in bringing the Ganges; was asked how she was to dispose of the sins of men discharged into her waters; भगीरथ said that साधुस् and others among whom was Hari would take off the sins from her: was asked to pray to शिव to check her course; so he prayed to शिव and it was heard; by this he was able to shake off the sins of his ancestors;
